description.en: Adds DSH sidebar panels for a Tonghuashun simulated account and local backtest replay, with positions, minute and daily K-lines, MA5/MA10, MACD, money flow, an order book and historical trade records.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏增加同花顺模拟账户持仓与回测回放面板，支持持仓、分钟与日线 K 线、MA5/MA10、MACD、资金流、五档盘口和历史交易记录。
